chakra.note_zh: 保留圖片中的七脈輪 Solfeggio 對照，並列太陽神經叢的 FSM 官方 200 Hz（由使用者確認）與圖片／Solfeggio 528 Hz，分別標示來源。此表與 FSM A／B 分開查閱；選取僅帶入數值，不代表治療配對或療效。
chakra.note_en: The seven Solfeggio chakra mappings from the photo coexist with FSM official solar plexus 200 Hz (confirmed by the user) and photo/Solfeggio 528 Hz, with separate source labels. This reference is kept separate from FSM A/B; applying a number does not establish a treatment pairing or effect.

solfeggio.note_zh: 依提供圖片收錄九個頻率，主題名稱為來源描述的中性改寫；圖片的「修復 DNA、器官修復、排毒」等宣稱未作為已證實效果收錄。這些聲音／傳統分類與 FSM 組織頻率意義不同。選取僅帶入數值，不代表治療配對或療效。
solfeggio.note_en: Nine frequencies from the supplied photo, with neutral paraphrases of its theme labels. Claims such as DNA repair, organ healing and detoxification are not presented as established effects. Sound/traditional classifications differ from FSM tissue frequency meanings. Applying a number does not establish a treatment pairing or effect.
